survivors.claim: The build's deviations record describes a fix (a queueGateTargetSpecs Set plus an internal __gateTargetPending sort clause in deriveNext() demoting a gate target's own entry) that does not exist anywhere in spec/scripts/spec-status.js, and was not actually needed for AC-20260903-03-2's fixture to pass (the target spec is unqueued/Infinity queuePos while the unrelated spec is queued, so ordinary queuePos ordering already produces the asserted next[0] with no demotion logic at all).
survivors.impact: A future reader who trusts the deviations record to explain how the gate-target ordering actually works will look for a mechanism (queueGateTargetSpecs / __gateTargetPending) that was never built, wasting time or drawing wrong conclusions about the sort logic.
survivors.evidence: grep -n "__gateTargetPending\|queueGateTargetSpecs" spec/scripts/spec-status.js returns no hits. node --test tests/queue/queue-overlay.test.js shows AC-20260903-03-2 and AC-20260903-03-3 passing (11/11 pass) with only the plain queuePos/blockers.length sort keys present at spec/scripts/spec-status.js:536-542.
